item.title: Huddle 1.1.1
item.description:
• Count build numbers from 1000, above the macOS 13 line's
  • Publish releases only to the public releases repository

item.title: Huddle 1.1.0
item.description: • Choose light or dark in Settings, whatever the Mac is set to

item.title: Huddle 0.13.4
item.description: • Choose light or dark in Settings, and see Settings change at once

item.title: Huddle 0.13.3
item.description: • Fix typing, room selection, Settings and scrolling on macOS 13

item.title: Huddle 1.0.0
item.description: • Build one app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs

item.title: Huddle 0.13.1
item.description: • Show a direct chat's person in Room Info, and open pictures large

item.title: Huddle 0.11.0
item.description:
• Add voice calls, with Element Call or the older one-to-one kind
  • Keep space tooltips from dropping out in a busy account
  • Stop a held reading place pulling the reader back as they scroll
  • Replace All Rooms with Home: chats and rooms outside spaces
  • Alert for the open room when Huddle's window is out of sight
  • Read the open room only while it's in front of you
  • Answer the pointer only in the window in front
  • Add New Section… to a space's menus
  • Move New Space to the foot of the space rail as a plain +

item.title: Huddle 0.10.0
item.description:
• Point to replies in old threads from the room list and the room
  • Make the open space and account easier to spot, and switch spaces at once
  • Add a Bubbles message layout
  • Bring the newest message back into view when a scroll lands short

item.title: Huddle 0.9.0
item.description:
• Add typing indicators, synced with Element, and two-way sharing
  • Use curly apostrophes in all on-screen text
  • Show who is verified in Room Info, and whether a room is encrypted

item.title: Huddle 0.8.0
item.description:
• Add Exclude unverified devices, and say why messages can't be read or sent
  • Warn about changed identities, mark doubtful messages, verify people
  • Ask the server how an identity reset is confirmed

item.title: Huddle 0.7.0
item.description: • Add recovery key setup and change, and identity reset

item.title: Huddle 0.5.0
item.description:
• Add sending and receiving files of any kind
  • Keep the window coming back at launch, and reopen the last room

item.title: Huddle 0.4.0
item.description:
• Patch the SDK's HTML library so deeply nested messages can't crash
  • Harden message handling, fix error text and keyboard gaps, cut redraws
  • Lay out About Huddle as MailMate's, as MailMateJ does

item.title: Huddle 0.3.0
item.description:
• Add an add-reaction chip after a message's reactions
  • Keep the hover bar with its message, and redraw the add-reaction button
  • Add per-room notification settings
  • Fix a crash when a sidebar section goes while the pointer is on its header
  • Add resizing the IRC layout's names column, remembered per room
  • Add reviewing and signing out an account's devices
  • Stop the history indexer from bloating rooms on screen
  • Open rooms at their newest message: only count input aimed at them
  • Add room list sections, shared with Element
  • Add editing your profile and changing your password
  • Show a notification's room in its space's room list

item.title: Huddle 0.2.0
item.description:
• Add Check for Updates, with Sparkle, and publish signed updates
  • Add changing member roles, and show role changes in the timeline
  • Add Room Info: details, inviting and removing members
  • Add group chats; make encryption a choice, off by default
  • Add starting a direct chat (File > New Message, Cmd-N)
  • Add message search over full history; move accounts to the title bar
  • Add spaces: rail, space browser, and creating, joining and leaving
  • Turn Settings into tabs: Notifications, Appearance, Privacy, Accounts
  • Add marking rooms read or unread, and large emoji
  • Add editing, deleting, pinning and forwarding; open rooms faster
  • Rework the thread panel: fit, resizing, and motion
  • Add presence, type-anywhere composing, and animated read receipts
  • Show timeline images whole instead of zoomed into their middle
  • Keep on-screen rooms subscribed so their previews stay current
  • Make your own reactions stand out
  • Replace Quick Look with an in-app image viewer; name files in previews
  • Add proper image support
  • Add replies
  • Add audio playback
  • Add notification settings and rebuild the Settings window
  • Render mentions and message formatting; add mention autocomplete
  • Add emoji picker, IRC layout and reaction previews; rework hover actions
  • Remove a room's alerts only when it is confirmed read
  • Stay on the newest message when a room reloads
  • Clear the "New" line once the room has been read
  • Add notification alerts
  • Reconnect sync by itself after a dropped connection
  • Add read receipts
  • Fix timeline flicker, blank rooms and not landing on the newest message
  • Add Slack-style threads
  • Show a blue number on account avatars for group room notifications
  • Badges: direct messages in red, no clipping, even gap
  • Rework notification badges on the account rail and room list
  • Redesign the sign-in screen
  • Sign in with username and password in the app, browser as fallback
  • Add README
